name: YieldMax
notes: Adviser is affiliated with ZEGA Financial; the YieldMax ETF brand launched its first funds (TSLY) in November 2022 and has since become the largest single-stock option-income ETF family by fund count.

name: GraniteShares
notes: Founded by Will Rhind; the YieldBOOST suite pairs a small leveraged/unlevered stock position with an options overlay for weekly income.

name: Roundhill Investments
notes: Founded by Will Hershey and Timothy Maloney; known for pioneering 0DTE (zero-days-to-expiration) covered call ETFs like QDTE and XDTE.

name: REX Shares
notes: Also operates the REX-Osprey joint venture for spot-crypto and crypto-staking ETFs.

name: NEOS Investments
notes: Known for a data-driven, tax-aware options approach (SPYI, QQQI) that emphasizes return-of-capital efficiency.

name: Defiance ETFs
notes: Led by CEO/CIO Sylvia Jablonski; also known for thematic ETFs outside the income lineup.

name: Amplify ETFs
notes: Founded by Christian Magoon; the CWP-subadvised DIVO/IDVO/QDVO suite uses selective (not 100%) call coverage.

name: Kurv Investment Management
notes: Sources differ on exact founding year (2022 vs 2023); left null pending clearer verification.

name: Nicholas Wealth Management / XFUNDS by Nicholas Wealth
primary_strategies: global equity + index credit spread income
notes: Founded by David Nicholas; the RIA's ETF sub-brand is marketed as "XFUNDS by Nicholas Wealth."

name: TappAlpha
notes: Operated by Tapp Finance, Inc.; partners with Tuttle Capital on its light-leverage "T2 Lift" series.

name: VistaShares
primary_strategies: Target 15 options-overlay income on concentrated/thematic equity baskets
notes: Founded by Adam Patti (previously founder of IndexIQ), launched with backing from DVx Ventures.

name: Tuttle Capital Management
notes: Founded by Matthew Tuttle; one of the most prolific independent ETF issuers by fund count, spanning many strategy types beyond income.

name: Simplify Asset Management
notes: Co-founded by Paul Kim (CEO); SVOL was one of the first ETFs to harvest VIX futures volatility premium with a built-in hedge.

name: NestYield
notes: Affiliated with Ramos Capital Group; smaller, newer issuer with a compact income-ETF lineup.

name: Calamos Investments
notes: Long-established multi-asset manager known for convertible bond expertise; entered the defined-outcome and autocallable-income ETF space more recently.

name: Grayscale Investments
notes: Best known for its spot Bitcoin/Ethereum trusts (GBTC, ETHE); more recently launched covered-call and premium-income ETFs on top of its crypto ETPs.

name: Global X ETFs
notes: Owned by Mirae Asset Global Investments; QYLD (2013) was one of the earliest and largest index covered-call ETFs.

name: JPMorgan Asset Management
notes: Asset management arm of JPMorgan Chase; JEPI (2020) and JEPQ (2022) are widely credited with popularizing actively managed equity premium income ETFs among mainstream investors.

name: Goldman Sachs Asset Management
notes: Asset management arm of Goldman Sachs; entered the premium-income ETF category in 2023 with GPIX and GPIQ.

name: First Trust / FT Vest
notes: "FT Vest" branding reflects First Trust's sub-advisory partnership with Cboe Vest on its large defined-outcome and target-income ETF suites.

name: Volatility Shares
notes: Best known for UVIX/SVIX; primarily a leveraged-and-inverse specialist rather than an option-income issuer, so it has no verified dedicated income-ETF product in this dataset.

name: Tradr ETFs
notes: First-to-market with single-stock leveraged ETFs in mid-2022; its lineup is leveraged/inverse daily-reset products, and no verified option-income (covered call) ETF from Tradr was found, so none are listed in funds.json.

name: Leverage Shares
headquarters: Greenwich, Connecticut, US (also operates from London, UK)
primary_strategies: covered call income ETPs (IncomeShares sub-brand, Europe)
notes: Primarily a European issuer of exchange-traded products (ETPs) listed on the LSE, Euronext, Xetra and Borsa Italiana, not US-listed ETFs; its IncomeShares sub-brand offers covered-call income ETPs (e.g. on gold, NVIDIA) in Europe only.
